decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed partial first floor side extension, hipped roof and rear dormer extension, by means of its size, scale, positioning, design and appearance would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the dwellings established appearance and would comply with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan; and is generally compliant with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant no undue adverse effects would result.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a first floor rear extension rear roof extension to dwellinghouse and construction of hipped roof over existing first floor side extension.
